event.event_name: January 2016 East Asia and subtropical Asia cold wave

criteria.name: Answer structure
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the requested cold-wave metrics and final answer.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct label with one missing secondary metric.

criteria.name: Temperature persistence and load
criteria.description: Computes 60 subzero hours and 177.4 C-h subzero load.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for one correct value or the correct formula with arithmetic error.

criteria.name: Wind-chill load
criteria.description: Applies the specified wind-chill formula and computes 149.4 C-h apparent stress.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for using wind chill but missing the -10 C load threshold.

criteria.name: Snow, precipitation, and image metrics
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for one or two correct supporting metrics.

criteria.name: Weighted index
criteria.description: Combines the six components with the stated weights to obtain 95.5 and the pass label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a correct pass state with a small weighted-sum error.

criteria.name: Bounded interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the diagnosis tied to thermal stress and supporting metrics rather than image-only or damage claims.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit for uncomputed damage or response claims.

provenance.notes: All values are computed from local CSX-045 package data without network access.
